abstract: We provide the first asymptotic analysis of the Boston Mechanism under equilibrium play in random markets. We provide two results. First, while 63% of students receive their first preference under truthful reporting–outperforming any other known mechanism in the literature–this rate converges to zero in any Nash equilibrium of the corresponding preference revelation game as the market size grows. Second, we show there exists a Nash equilibrium where the average student receives a dramatically inferior assignment: in markets with 1,000 students, the average placement shifts from the 7th choice (under truthfulness) to the 145th choice, representing a change from logarithmic to nearly linear average rank.
abstract_zh: 我们首次对随机市场中均衡行为下的波士顿机制进行了渐近分析。我们提供了两项结果。第一，尽管在真实报告下，63%的学生能获得其首选偏好——这一比例超越了文献中任何其他已知机制——但在相应的偏好揭示博弈中，随着市场规模扩大，这一比例在任何纳什均衡下都趋近于零。第二，我们证明存在一个纳什均衡，其中平均学生获得的分配结果显著恶化：在拥有1000名学生的市场中，平均分配位置从第7选择（在真实报告下）移至第145选择，这标志着平均排名从对数级转变为近乎线性级。
title: A note on the strategic vulnerability of the Boston mechanism in random markets
title_zh: 关于随机市场中波士顿机制策略脆弱性的一个注记

abstract: • In early modern England, censorship permanently boosted cultural innovativeness. • Between 1525 and 1700, English censorship had a chilling effect on quantity, but only temporarily. • English cultural production was especially innovative in Tudor times and the Civil War era. • LLMs contain sufficient information to construct a historical index of censorship. • Cultural innovation and quantity can be measured using machine learning applied to early modern texts. The effects of print censorship on early modern England's cultural production have yet to be examined quantitatively. Doing so requires distilling dispersed qualitative information into numerical data. An annual index of print censorship is constructed by eliciting the historical knowledge encoded in a large language model (LLM) primed with evidence from secondary sources. Application of a machine-learning (ML) algorithm to a major corpus provides document-level measures of cultural innovativeness (quality) and volume (quantity). Pre-existing topic-model estimates apportion each document among distinct cultural themes—three affected by censorship and five unaffected. This yields a yearly theme-level panel for 1525–1700. Local projections estimate censorship's dynamic effects. Counterintuitively, censorship increases innovativeness in censorship-affected themes relative to non-affected themes. Censorship has a temporary chilling effect on the quantity of cultural production though output recovers within a decade. Results are robust to an instrumental-variable approach addressing the endogeneity of censorship. Findings are unchanged when the censorship index is constructed using three alternative LLMs. Leveraging LLMs and ML to measure hard-to-quantify phenomena, such as censorship and cultural production, illuminates the drivers of cultural evolution.
title: Innovation under censorship: Effects on cultural production in early modern England
title_zh: 审查制度下的创新：对近代早期英格兰文化生产的影响

abstract: ABSTRACT Rice is the main staple food for more than half of the world's population and the income from rice is an essential source for livelihoods of millions of households. We examine whether direct seed in rice production is an adaptation of rice farmers to rainfall changes and farm labor scarcity. The results show that the deficit changes of rainfall positively associate with the application of direct‐seeded rice. After addressing the simultaneity between direct‐seeded rice application and off‐farm employment, we find a positive correlation of off‐farm employment with direct‐seeded rice application. Thus, stimulating direct‐seeded rice application is recommended for enhancing the adaptation of rice farmers to rainfall changes and for fostering rural transformation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 水稻是全球超过半数人口的主要口粮，其收入也是数百万家庭生计的重要来源。本文考察了水稻生产中的直接播种是否为稻农应对降雨变化和农业劳动力短缺的一种适应策略。结果显示，降雨亏缺变化与直接播种水稻的应用呈正相关。在解决了直接播种水稻应用与离农就业之间的同时性问题后，我们发现离农就业与直接播种水稻应用之间存在正相关关系。因此，建议推广直接播种水稻的应用，以增强稻农对降雨变化的适应能力，并促进农村转型。
title: Adapting to Changing Rainfall and Developing Off‐Farm Employment: Implications for the Adoption of Direct Seeding in Rice Production
title_zh: 适应降雨变化与发展非农就业：对水稻生产采用直播种植的影响

abstract: This paper studies how attacks against journalists affect news media activity. We combine data on content shared by Mexican media outlets on Twitter with records of journalist assassinations between 2010 and 2020, and use difference-in-differences methods that are robust to staggered treatment and heterogeneous effects. Our analysis shows that reporting activity of affiliated outlets declines significantly in the months after journalists are killed, relative to outlets not yet exposed to a killing. Additionally, we observe subtle shifts in the tone of news coverage and a significant increase in grammatical errors. Using census data, we also document that the number of active journalists declines in places where killings occur, and that their demographic characteristics shift: remaining journalists tend to be younger, less educated, less likely to be married, and less likely to have children.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了针对记者的袭击如何影响新闻媒体的活动。我们将墨西哥媒体机构在推特上分享的内容数据与2010年至2020年间记者遇害的记录相结合，并采用对交错处理及异质性效应稳健的双重差分方法进行分析。分析显示，在记者遇害后的数月内，关联媒体的报道活动显著减少，相较于尚未遭遇此类事件的媒体机构。此外，我们观察到新闻报道基调的微妙变化以及语法错误的显著增加。利用人口普查数据，我们还记录了遇害事件发生地活跃记者数量的下降，且其人口特征发生转变：留任记者往往更年轻、受教育程度较低、已婚可能性较小，且生育子女的可能性也较低。
title: Violence against journalists and freedom of the press: Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: 针对记者的暴力与新闻自由：来自墨西哥的证据
